intro: Timeless yet functional, the Cubicon sofa is a true home investment. With supportive cushions, luxurious fabric, and built-in storage, it's perfect for hosting guests or unwinding in comfort.

features.title: Dual-purpose design for flexible living
features.text: Whether you need extra seating or a comfortable bed, the Cubicon easily transforms from a stylish three-seater sofa to a spacious queen-size bed in seconds.

features.title: Hidden storage to keep things tidy
features.text: The under-seat storage compartment is perfect for stashing blankets, pillows, or seasonal items, keeping your space clutter-free and organised.

features.title: Cushions that double as extra support
features.text: Portable back cushions can be used as additional support on the floor or anywhere you need them, adding versatility to your home.

features.title: Easy-to-use pull-out bed mechanism
features.text: Switching between sofa and bed is smooth and effortless, making it a practical choice for both small spaces and busy households.

features.title: Built for lasting durability
features.text: Built with a solid pinewood frame treated for termite resistance, this sofa bed ensures durability and structural integrity.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
